# Haalarikone Documentation

## Site
- [Home](https://haalarikone.fi/)
- [Sitemap XML](https://haalarikone.fi/sitemap.xml)
- [Robots](https://haalarikone.fi/robots.txt)

## Locales
- [Finnish (default)](https://haalarikone.fi/)
- [English](https://haalarikone.fi/en)
- [Swedish](https://haalarikone.fi/sv)

## Main Sections
- [Blog](https://haalarikone.fi/blog)
- [Universities](https://haalarikone.fi/oppilaitos)
- [Fields](https://haalarikone.fi/ala)
- [Colors](https://haalarikone.fi/vari)

## URL Patterns
- `/{locale?}/blog/{slug}`
- `/{locale?}/oppilaitos/{slug}`
- `/{locale?}/ala/{slug}`
- `/{locale?}/vari/{slug}`
- `/{locale?}/alue/{slug}`
- `/{locale?}/haalari/{slug}` (Finnish default path segment)
- `/{locale?}/overall/{slug}` (English)
- `/{locale?}/overaller/{slug}` (Swedish)

## Agent Crawl Guidance
- Follow `robots.txt` directives.
- Use `sitemap.xml` for discovery.
- Prefer canonical public content pages.
